name: News-sentiment overreaction fade on 4h bars (headline-shock reversal, long)
rationale: MECHANISM: GDELT/news-sentiment research shows retail disproportionately reacts to bearish headlines and social sentiment drives 30-40% of short-term volatility; the reaction is an emotional overshoot that reverts once the headline's (usually small) information content is digested. Counterparty: liquidity providers / patient buyers who fade the emotional tape and collect the reversion premium. This lives on 4h because the overreaction-and-snapback happens within hours; fractional-hold + real-fee support let us hold a few bars. Entry: news_sentiment in an extreme LOW tail AND a matching price shock down (ret_Nd below a fitted floor) — fade only large shocks confirmed by price. Long the bounce; exit fast on time_stop or TP. DISCONFIRMER: the reversion premium must survive REAL 4h round-trip fees — if per-trade net edge < 2x fee+slippage, it is a mirage; kill. Second: if the fade works equally on RANDOM 4h bars (not just extreme-tone bars), it is plain short-horizon mean-reversion and news_sentiment adds no information — kill.
catalyst: extreme-negative news sentiment confirmed by a price shock down
